bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError
token=(Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/tumblr-operation-app/tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
query="SELECT topic_id FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 1"
topic=subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",query],text=True,timeout=10).strip()
assert topic.isdecimal(), "TOPIC_MISSING"
url="http://127.0.0.1:8081/assistant"
def assistant(data):
    req=Request(url,json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","Authorization":"Bearer "+token},method="POST")
    with urlopen(req,timeout=22) as r:
        assert r.status==200
        return json.load(r)
r=assistant({"selected_action":"telegram.check_membership","selected_target":topic+":1"})
assert r["state"]=="unverified",("MEMBERSHIP_CALLER_FAILED",r.get("state"),r.get("action"))
p=assistant({"selected_action":"telegram.publish_announcement","selected_target":topic,"message":"本文: 🧪 内部接続プレビュー（未投稿）"})
assert p["state"]=="confirmation_required" and p.get("request_id") and not p["executed"],("ANNOUNCEMENT_PREVIEW_FAILED",p.get("state"))
assert "未投稿" in p["text"]
print("APP_TO_BOT_MEMBERSHIP_REAL_NEGATIVE=PASS")
print("APP_ANNOUNCEMENT_PREVIEW_NO_SEND=PASS")
PY
